name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A single inline link trigger inside Root that opens an image-and-summary preview popup anchored to the link.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no open/onOpenChange props and no React state in the demo; Root manages open state entirely internally
nonTrivialInteractions: trigger is a real link (href to Wikipedia) that opens the popup on hover and focus without navigating
popup closes on trigger blur and Escape (internal behavior the demo relies on)
arrow is repositioned per popup side via data-side attribute selectors

name: detached-triggers-simple
whatItDemonstrates: The most minimal detached-trigger setup: a handle from PreviewCard.createHandle() links a Trigger placed outside Root to the Root that renders a static preview popup.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no open/onOpenChange props and no React state; Root manages open state internally
nonTrivialInteractions: Trigger sits outside PreviewCard.Root and is linked via a shared handle created by PreviewCard.createHandle()
popup content is static (no payload and no function-as-child) — the same content shows regardless of trigger

name: detached-triggers-full
whatItDemonstrates: Three detached triggers sharing one typed handle, each supplying its own payload that Root renders via function-as-child, with Viewport-driven position, size, and content morph animations.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no open/onOpenChange props and no React state; which content renders derives from the active trigger's payload
nonTrivialInteractions: three detached triggers share one typed handle created as PreviewCard.createHandle<React.ReactElement>()
function-as-child Root destructures { payload } to render per-trigger content
Viewport provides direction-aware enter/exit animations keyed off the space-separated data-activation-direction attribute matched with ~= ('left'/'right') on data-current/data-previous containers
positioner box is frozen to measured size via --positioner-width/--positioner-height with top/left/right/bottom/transform transitions, while Popup transitions width/height/opacity/transform

name: detached-triggers-controlled
whatItDemonstrates: Three payload-carrying detached triggers driven by externally controlled open and triggerId state, including programmatic opening of a specific trigger from a plain button.
stateManaged: controlled — two useState hooks wrap open (boolean) and triggerId (string | null), passed to Root as open/triggerId; onOpenChange sets open and derives triggerId from eventDetails.trigger?.id
nonTrivialInteractions: external 'Open programmatically' button sets triggerId='trigger-2' and open=true to open the popup anchored to a specific trigger
onOpenChange syncs both controlled values, deriving the active trigger id from eventDetails.trigger?.id
each trigger has an explicit id (trigger-1/2/3) matching the triggerId values used for controlled anchoring
per-trigger payload content is selected via the function-as-child { payload } render prop
